about.title: About ROI Calculator
about.description: The ROI (Return on Investment) Calculator is a financial analysis tool that helps you measure the percentage return on an investment relative to its cost. Whether you're evaluating business investments, real estate purchases, stock portfolios, or marketing campaigns, this tool provides a simple way to compare gain or loss scenarios and review investment performance.

faq.q: What is a good ROI percentage?
faq.a: A good ROI varies by investment type and risk level. Stock market averages 7-10% annually, real estate typically 8-12%, while high-risk investments may target 15%+ returns. Compare ROI against similar investments and consider risk factors.
ROI = (Current Value - Initial Investment - Additional Costs) / (Initial Investment + Additional Costs) × 100. For annualized ROI, divide by the number of years and multiply by 100 for percentage.

faq.q: Should I include taxes in ROI calculation?
faq.a: Yes, include all costs including taxes, fees, and maintenance expenses for a more complete ROI estimate. This helps you review net return after all expenses.

faq.q: What's the difference between ROI and annualized ROI?
faq.a: ROI shows total return over the entire investment period, while annualized ROI shows the average yearly return. Annualized ROI is better for comparing investments with different time periods.
